spans.s: --the गति of the sun; when the sun is in माघ it moves past southward; returning from the south [page२-745+ ३७] it goes to विषु rising in the north of the milky ocean; when the sun is in श्रवण नक्षत्र it goes to the north and rises in the north end of शाकद्वीपम्. वा. ५०. १२१-7.
--a गण born of मुहूर्ता and Dharma. These regulate the timely results of the actions of Beings. भा.
